sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中走过七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个锅搞定的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界，充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受优惠，网址 nytimes.com 后面加斜杠 subscribe。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Most weekends we bring you the Sunday read, but today we're doing something a little bit different, sharing the latest episode of Modern Love, a podcast from New York Times Audio
sentences.zh: 大多数周末我们会为您带来周日阅读，但今天我们要换个方式，分享《现代爱情》（Modern Love）的最新一期节目，这是《纽约时报》音频部出品的播客

sentences.en: that explores the complicated love lives of regular people.
sentences.zh: 它探索了普通人复杂的爱情生活。

sentences.en: Enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 好好享受吧。

sentences.en: And if you like it, head over to the Modern Love feed for new episodes every Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢，请前往《现代爱情》订阅源，每周三收听新节目。

sentences.en: Take a listen.
sentences.zh: 听听看。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Anna Martin.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是安娜·马丁。

sentences.en: This is Modern Love.
sentences.zh: 这里是《现代爱情》。

sentences.en: Welcome to a new season.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到新一季。

sentences.en: If you listen to the show, you're clearly into stories about relationships.
sentences.zh: 如果你听过这个节目，你显然对人际关系的故事很感兴趣。

sentences.en: So you may have heard of a guy named Dave Finch.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能听说过一个叫戴夫·芬奇的家伙。

sentences.en: There was a time when a lot of people wanted to hear his ideas about making relationships work, because he seemed to have solved a big problem in his own marriage.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，很多人想听听他关于如何让亲密关系运作的想法，因为他似乎解决了自己婚姻中的一个大问题。

sentences.en: As he tells it, the problem stemmed from his overpowering need for order and predictability.
sentences.zh: 正如他所说，问题源于他对于秩序和可预测性的强烈需求。

sentences.en: And it came out in all kinds of everyday situations, with his wife, Kristen, and their two kids.
sentences.zh: 这种需求表现在他与妻子克里斯汀以及两个孩子的各种日常生活情境中。

sentences.en: Take this for example.
sentences.zh: 举个例子。

sentences.en: I had it in my head that nap time was 10 o'clock and 2 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里认为午睡时间是10点和2点。

sentences.en: And if the two o'clock nap didn't happen because somebody dropped over for a visit or because
sentences.zh: 如果两点钟的午睡没有发生，因为有人顺道来访，或者因为

sentences.en: they were, you know, fussy and not going down for a nap, I would start to almost spiral in a way.
sentences.zh: 他们，你知道的，哭闹着不肯睡觉，我几乎就要情绪崩溃了。

sentences.en: It was this sense of panic.
sentences.zh: 那是一种恐慌感。

sentences.en: And I would lash out and try to seize control.
sentences.zh: 我会发脾气，并试图夺回控制权。

sentences.en: And she would say, why are you freaking out, Dave?
sentences.zh: 而她会说，戴夫，你为什么发疯？

sentences.en: If I already have two babies who won't go down for a nap, and now I have a husband who's freaking out because babies won't.
sentences.zh: 如果我已经有两个宝宝不肯睡觉，现在又有一个丈夫因为宝宝不睡觉而发疯。

sentences.en: They're babies.
sentences.zh: 他们是宝宝。

sentences.en: They don't always take a nap.
sentences.zh: 他们不总是肯睡午觉的。

sentences.en: And I remember saying to her, you told me nap time is 10 and 2.
sentences.zh: 我记得我对她说，你告诉我午睡时间是10点和2点。

sentences.en: So if it's not 10 and 2, you have to tell me that.
sentences.zh: 所以如果不是10点和2点，你必须告诉我。

sentences.en: And she was thinking, why would I have to tell you that?
sentences.zh: 而她心里想的是，我为什么要告诉你这个？

sentences.en: Be an adult.
sentences.zh: 成熟一点。

sentences.en: Don't be a third person in this house I have to take care of.
sentences.zh: 别当这个家里我还要照顾的第三个人。

sentences.en: Tensions kept building between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 两人之间的紧张关系不断升级。

sentences.en: But then they had a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 但随后他们有了突破。

sentences.en: Dave went to a psychiatriSt.
sentences.zh: 戴夫去看了一位精神科医生。

sentences.en: Five minutes into the conversation, I was like, you can stop.
sentences.zh: 谈话才进行五分钟，我就说，你可以停下了。

sentences.en: You have Asperger's.
sentences.zh: 你得了阿斯伯格综合征。

sentences.en: This was in 2008.
So they were still using the word Asperger's.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当时还在使用“阿斯伯格综合征”这个词。

sentences.en: But it was so revelatory for me because for three years, the most important person in my life was saying things like, you just don't get it, Dave.
sentences.zh: 但这对我来说太有启发了，因为三年来，我生命中最重要的人一直在说这样的话：你就是不明白，戴夫。

sentences.en: And in that moment, she saw me not as a husband who is a walking checklist of deficits, but
sentences.zh: 而在那一刻，她看我的眼光不再是一个满身缺点、像行走的检查清单一样的丈夫，而是

sentences.en: as a human being who is wired a certain way, who doesn't mean to be making things difficult all the time.
sentences.zh: 一个天生如此、并不是故意要一直把事情搞砸的人类。

sentences.en: It's not all his fault.
sentences.zh: 这不全是他的错。

sentences.en: These days, the term Asperger's isn't used much, but it refers to an autism spectrum disorder.
sentences.zh: 如今，“阿斯伯格”这个术语已经不常用了，但它指的是孤独症谱系障碍。

sentences.en: After that diagnosis, Dave began to understand all the ways his brain worked differently.
sentences.zh: 确诊之后，戴夫开始理解他大脑运作方式的所有不同之处。

sentences.en: The autistic mind craves predictability.
sentences.zh: 孤独症患者的大脑渴望可预测性。

sentences.en: And when that prediction doesn't match reality, it's considered a personal violation.
sentences.zh: 而当这种预测与现实不符时，就会被认为是对个人的侵犯。

sentences.en: And that's why the autistic brain starts to spiral and feel very anxious and dysregulated.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么孤独症患者的大脑会开始崩溃，并感到非常焦虑和失调。

sentences.en: I needed to understand what was expected of me, how I needed to show up in those situations.
sentences.zh: 我需要了解别人对我的期望，我需要在那些情况下如何表现。

sentences.en: I really needed a sense of control, a sense of structure, a sense of predictability.
sentences.zh: 我真的需要一种控制感、一种结构感、一种可预测性。

sentences.en: Dave couldn't get predictability, but maybe he could figure out how to be a better partner.
sentences.zh: 戴夫无法获得可预测性，但他或许能弄清楚如何成为一个更好的伴侣。

sentences.en: So he came up with an idea.
sentences.zh: 于是他想出了一个主意。

sentences.en: Every time Kristen got frustrated with him about something he did or didn't do, he wrote it down so maybe he could get it right the next time.
sentences.zh: 每当克里斯汀因为他做了或没做什么而感到沮丧时，他就把它写下来，这样下次他可能就能做对。

sentences.en: One rule he had was, be present in moments with the kids, which meant playing with them instead of getting annoyed when they didn't follow exactly the rules of a game.
sentences.zh: 他的一条规则是，在和孩子在一起的时刻要专注，这意味着陪他们玩，而不是在他们没有严格遵守游戏规则时感到恼火。

sentences.en: Another rule was, just listen.
sentences.zh: 另一条规则是，倾听就好。

sentences.en: When Kristen had a problem, she didn't need a literal spreadsheet of solutions.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯汀遇到问题时，她需要的不是一份密密麻麻的解决方案电子表格。

sentences.en: All she wanted was for him to show a little empathy.
sentences.zh: 她想要的只是他表现出一点同理心。

sentences.en: Dave's list of rules got longer and longer.
sentences.zh: 戴夫的规则清单越来越长。

sentences.en: Don't change the radio station when she's singing along.
sentences.zh: 她在跟着唱歌时不要换电台。

sentences.en: Don't sneak up on her and surprise her when she's pouring coffee.
sentences.zh: 在她倒咖啡时不要突然出现吓她一跳。

sentences.en: She hates that.
sentences.zh: 她讨厌那样。

sentences.en: Apologies do not count when you shout them.
sentences.zh: 大喊大叫的道歉不算数。

sentences.en: Don't just take what you need from the dryer.
sentences.zh: 不要只从烘干机里拿走你需要的衣服。

sentences.en: Fold all the clothes and put them away.
sentences.zh: 把所有的衣服都叠好并收起来。

sentences.en: He wrote all these rules down on post-it notes and little scraps of paper and kept them in a drawer in his bedside table.
sentences.zh: 他把所有的规则都写在便利贴和碎纸片上，放在床头柜的抽屉里。

sentences.en: Dave talked about all this in a modern love essay, which led to a bestselling book called
sentences.zh: 戴夫在一篇《现代爱情》随笔中谈到了这一切，这促成了一本畅销书，书名是

sentences.en: The Journal of Best Practices, A Memoir of Marriage, Asperger's Syndrome, and One Man's
sentences.zh: 《最佳实践手册：婚姻、阿斯伯格综合征与一个男人成为更好丈夫的追求》

sentences.en: Quest to Be a Better Husband.
sentences.zh: 成为更好丈夫的探索之旅。

sentences.en: And he became a public speaker.
sentences.zh: 他成了一名公众演讲者。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I am Dave.
sentences.zh: 我是戴夫。

sentences.en: And it's really exciting for me to be able to come and talk to you this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上能来这里和大家交流，我真的非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Sharing what he learned with other struggling couples.
sentences.zh: 与其他苦苦挣扎的夫妻分享他的所学。

sentences.en: The big game changer for people is adaptability.
sentences.zh: 对人们来说，最大的转折点是适应能力。

sentences.en: A willingness and an ability to change, to adapt, to unlearn old behaviors, I mean, it's hard.
sentences.zh: 一种改变、适应、抛弃旧行为的意愿和能力，我是说，这很难。

sentences.en: But it is possible.
sentences.zh: 但这是可能的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Seems like a happy ending, right?
sentences.zh: 听起来像是一个大团圆结局，对吧？

sentences.en: But listen to this one interview Dave did at the time.
sentences.zh: 但听听戴夫当时做的这个采访。

sentences.en: Ira Glass, the host of This American Life, asked Dave how Kristen felt about one of his best practices.
sentences.zh: 《美国生活》（This American Life）的主持人艾拉·格拉斯问戴夫，克里斯汀对他的其中一项最佳实践有何感受。

sentences.en: It was the rule about acting empathetic.
sentences.zh: 那是关于表现出同理心的规则。

sentences.en: But wait, is that satisfying for her?
sentences.zh: 但等等，这能让她感到满足吗？

sentences.en: I mean, if you say to her, like, God, that must be terrible for you, and you're not really empathizing, and she knows you're just saying it by rote because you've been trained to
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果你对她说，天哪，这对你来说一定太糟糕了，而你并没有真正的同理心，她知道你只是因为被训练过而机械地这么说

sentences.en: do it, is that actually satisfying to her?
sentences.zh: 这真的能让她感到满足吗？

sentences.en: That's a really great point.
sentences.zh: 这真的是个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I can now surmise, you know, using intellect, that, yes, that must have been very trying for her.
sentences.zh: 我现在可以推测，你知道，利用理性，是的，那对她来说一定非常折磨。

sentences.en: Still, Dave stuck to his best practices for a few more years.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，戴夫还是坚持他的最佳实践又过了几年。

sentences.en: Until one day.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天。

sentences.en: I'd just gotten out of the shower, and Kristen marched into the bathroom and said, I have a revelation to share with you.
sentences.zh: 我刚洗完澡出来，克里斯汀大步走进浴室说，我有一个启示要告诉你。

sentences.en: We're done being married.
sentences.zh: 我们的婚姻结束了。

sentences.en: We're just done.
sentences.zh: 彻底结束了。

sentences.en: And I said, wait, wait, wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 我说，等等，等等，等等。

sentences.en: What do you mean we're done?
sentences.zh: 什么叫我们结束了？

sentences.en: She's like, this marriage, this thing we're doing, the thing we've been doing, and it's exhausting for both of us, we're not doing that anymore.
sentences.zh: 她说，这段婚姻，我们一直在做的事，我们一直在维持的状态，这对我们俩来说都太累了，我们再也不这样做了。

sentences.en: We're just, we're done being married.
sentences.zh: 我们只是，我们的婚姻结束了。

sentences.en: And I said, wait a minute, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 我说，等一下，等一下。

sentences.en: I've been doing the best practices.
sentences.zh: 我一直在实行最佳实践。

sentences.en: I've been working the method.
sentences.zh: 我一直在执行这套方法。

sentences.en: I'm about to go give a lecture in Missouri about how to be a great partner in a marriage.
sentences.zh: 我正要去了密苏里州做一个关于如何在婚姻中成为一个好伴侣的讲座。

sentences.en: I said, so we were separating?
sentences.zh: 我说，所以我们要分居了？

sentences.en: She said, no, more like we're detaching.
sentences.zh: 她说，不，更像是我们要脱离彼此。

sentences.en: And I remember asking, detaching?
sentences.zh: 我记得我问过，脱离彼此？

sentences.en: What does that even mean?
sentences.zh: 那到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: Because to me, it sounds like we're not married anymore.
sentences.zh: 因为在我看来，听起来就像我们不再是夫妻了。

sentences.en: And she said, you know what, Dave?
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道吗，戴夫？

sentences.en: We'll call this unmarried.
sentences.zh: 我们就管这叫“未婚”。

sentences.en: And then she just turned around and left the room.
sentences.zh: 然后她转过身就走出了房间。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是维纳卢。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼字游戏“连连看”（Connections）。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马泽斯基，我每天创作“拼写蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母箱”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色听症的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 后面加斜杠 games，今天就开始游戏。

sentences.en: Kristen had just dropped this major bomb on Dave, right as he was getting out of the shower, no less.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀刚刚向戴夫投下了这颗重磅炸弹，而且恰好是在他刚洗完澡出来的时候。

sentences.en: So was this the end of their marriage, or just another bump in the road?
sentences.zh: 所以，这是他们婚姻的终结，还是仅仅是路上的又一个坎？我邀请了戴夫坐下来和我谈谈这件事。

sentences.en: I asked Dave to sit down and talk with me about it.
sentences.zh: 我邀请了戴夫坐下来和我谈谈这件事。

sentences.en: Dave, welcome to Modern Love.
sentences.zh: 戴夫，欢迎来到《现代爱情》。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你来到节目中。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I can't wait to have this conversation together.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待地想进行这次对话。

sentences.en: So let's pick up where we left off.
sentences.zh: 那么我们从上次中断的地方继续吧。

sentences.en: What did you do after Kristen told you she wanted to be unmarried?
sentences.zh: 当克里斯汀告诉你她想变成“未婚”时，你做了什么？

sentences.en: You were literally heading to give a talk about how to have a successful marriage.
sentences.zh: 你当时正要去作一个关于如何拥有美满婚姻的演讲。

sentences.en: I had to climb in the car and drive all the way down through Illinois to get to Missouri.
sentences.zh: 我不得不上车，一路穿过伊利诺伊州开到密苏里州。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And then drive through Missouri.
sentences.zh: 然后穿过密苏里州开车。

sentences.en: And I had given so many talks at that point.
sentences.zh: 那时候我已经做过太多次演讲了。

sentences.en: I wasn't worried.
sentences.zh: 我不担心。

sentences.en: I knew I could get my way through the talk.
sentences.zh: 我知道自己能顺利完成演讲。

sentences.en: The bigger picture was like, I'm about to go tell these people this.
sentences.zh: 更大的画面是，我正要去告诉这些人这些。

sentences.en: And my wife just said, I don't want to be married anymore.
sentences.zh: 而我妻子刚说过，我不想再结婚了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: What was going through your head on that drive?
sentences.zh: 那次开车时，你脑子里在想什么？

sentences.en: I just replayed that moment over and over.
sentences.zh: 我只是在脑海里一遍又一遍地回放那一刻。

sentences.en: What could she mean?
sentences.zh: 她到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: I didn't go to a place of positivity when she said that.
sentences.zh: 当她那样说的时候，我的脑子里没有浮现出任何积极的画面。

sentences.en: The eight or nine hours I had in the car right after that moment were catastrophizing and trying to imagine new scenarios of what our life would look like.
sentences.zh: 在那之后的八九个小时里，我坐在车里，脑子里全是灾难化的想象，不断构想着我们未来的生活会变成什么样的新剧本。

sentences.en: But really, it was just replaying with deafening loudness the conversation that we had had that morning.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，那不过是在以震耳欲聋的音量，反复回放我们那天早上谈话的场景。

sentences.en: Oh, Dave, I'm like feeling really crushed.
sentences.zh: 哦，戴夫，我感觉真的被压垮了。

sentences.en: It was a moment where I felt I had lost my partner.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我感觉自己失去了伴侣。

sentences.en: I was starting to feel what must have been grief.
sentences.zh: 我开始感受到那必然是悲伤的情绪。

sentences.en: What you thought it meant then was, we're done.
sentences.zh: 你当时以为那意味着：我们完了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It just sounded to me like this is the first step in what is ultimately going to lead to divorce.
sentences.zh: 在我听来，这就像是最终通向离婚的第一步。

sentences.en: And I thought, it's not even that I need Kristen to be my wife.
sentences.zh: 而且我想的甚至不是我需不需要克里斯滕做我的妻子。

sentences.en: The scary thing for me was, everything I was doing, it's still not good enough.
sentences.zh: 让我感到害怕的是，我所做的一切，依然还不够好。

sentences.en: Like, how is this person going to stay in my life if I can't be good enough even after all this work?
sentences.zh: 就像是，如果我付出了这一切努力却依然不够好，这个人怎么还可能留在我的生命里？

sentences.en: That was the scariest part for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那是让人最害怕的部分。

sentences.en: In the days and weeks after that conversation in the bathroom, you started to see what Kristen meant by unmarrying.
sentences.zh: 在浴室里的那次谈话之后的几天和几周里，你开始明白克里斯滕所说的“解除婚姻”是什么意思了。

sentences.en: What did you see her doing as she put unmarrying into action in her own life?
sentences.zh: 当她将“解除婚姻”付诸现实生活时，你看到她都在做些什么？

sentences.en: So I was very confused.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时非常困惑。

sentences.en: And since she wouldn't give me a definitive, we are terminating the marriage, I knew that we were still in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 既然她不肯给我一个确切的答复——也就是我们要终止这段婚姻，我便知道我们仍然处于恋爱关系中。

sentences.en: And I remember even asking her at one point, I was like, am I supposed to be like dating other people?
sentences.zh: 我甚至记得自己曾一度问她，我说，我是不是应该去和别人约会？

sentences.en: She's like, God, no.
sentences.zh: 她说，天哪，绝不。

sentences.en: I was like, okay, so we're still faithful to each other, right?
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，那我们依然对彼此忠诚，对吧？

sentences.en: And which is good because I don't want to go out there and start dating people.
sentences.zh: 这挺好的，因为我也不想出门去跟别人约会。

sentences.en: And I'd asked her, like, does that mean I don't have to do household chores?
sentences.zh: 我曾问过她，比如，这是否意味着我不用做家务了？

sentences.en: Or like, she's like, no, you still have to do the dishes.
sentences.zh: 或者类似的话，她说，不，你还是得洗碗。

sentences.en: You still have to, I was like, ah, damn it.
sentences.zh: 你还得……我说，啊，真该死。

sentences.en: But as I started observing her, what she was doing was going out and having long coffee dates with friends.
sentences.zh: 但当我开始观察她时，发现她所做的事就是出门和朋友们进行长时间的咖啡约会。

sentences.en: And she was treating herself to leisurely strolls in the mid-morning.
sentences.zh: 她会在上午悠闲地散步，以此来犒劳自己。

sentences.en: She was journaling.
sentences.zh: 她开始写日记。

sentences.en: She was reading books by Brene Brown and Annie Lamott and all these great thinkers.
sentences.zh: 她阅读布琳·布朗、安妮·拉莫特以及所有这些伟大思想家的书籍。

sentences.en: And she was like, Dave, go mountain biking, take trips by yourself, go whatever.
sentences.zh: 她会对我说：戴夫，去骑山地车吧，自己一个人去旅行，随便去干点什么。

sentences.en: And so I started aping her work.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始模仿她的做法。

sentences.en: Okay, Dave, I got to know what that meant for you.
sentences.zh: 好了，戴夫，我必须知道那对你意味着什么。

sentences.en: So I started saying, well, I've noticed that she's really gotten into essential oils and burning white sage and energy clearing the house.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始琢磨，我注意到她真的很迷恋精油、燃烧白鼠艾草以及给房子清理能量。

sentences.en: I could do that, too.
sentences.zh: 这我也能做到。

sentences.en: So check this out.
sentences.zh: 所以，来看看这个。

sentences.en: Here's my white sage that I still.
sentences.zh: 这是我的白鼠尾草，我至今还留着它。

sentences.en: Well, there you go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这倒挺有意思。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I went full woo for about three months where I was like, you know, I had my chakras tested.
sentences.zh: 我有大概三个月的时间完全陷入了玄学，当时我就觉得，你知道的，我测试了自己的脉轮。

sentences.en: And that didn't feel right.
sentences.zh: 但这感觉不对劲。

sentences.en: I was like, I'm not experiencing the joy that she seems to be experiencing in her new Kristen renaissance of just living her life outside of the marriage.
sentences.zh: 我在想，我并没有体验到她似乎在她那崭新的克里斯滕文艺复兴中所体验到的那种快乐，那种在婚姻之外单纯生活的快乐。

sentences.en: So then I tried to get myself some friends and I architected how to get friends.
sentences.zh: 于是我试着给自己找些朋友，并开始琢磨怎么去结交朋友。

sentences.en: And I went out there and I experimented and I was needing from them all the stuff I was needing from Kristen, which was like this constant sort of, you know, brotherhood,
sentences.zh: 我走了出去，进行了尝试，我从他们身上索取着我一直向克里斯滕索取的一切，比如那种源源不断的，你知道的，兄弟情谊，

sentences.en: companionship, awesomeness.
sentences.zh: 陪伴感，以及酷炫的体验。

sentences.en: And after a while, I was too much for them.
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，我让他们有些吃不消了。

sentences.en: And they were like, dude, no, I don't want to be macho with you anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们对我说：老兄，别这样，我不想再陪你搞什么大男子主义了。

sentences.en: This sucks.
sentences.zh: 这太逊了。

sentences.en: I mean, during this time, if you went somewhere together and you had to introduce her, what would you even say?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在这期间，如果你和她一起去某个地方，不得不介绍她时，你甚至会说些什么？

sentences.en: Like, how would you explain your situation to someone?
sentences.zh: 比如，你会怎么向别人解释你们的状况？

sentences.en: So at this time, I was meeting a lot of new people, a lot of philanthropists, a lot of business people.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时候，我遇到了很多新面孔，很多慈善家，很多商界人士。

sentences.en: And I had to go to a bunch of different functions and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我不得不参加各种不同的社交活动之类的。

sentences.en: And sometimes Kristen came along.
sentences.zh: 有时克里斯滕也会同行。

sentences.en: And when we went somewhere and I would introduce her, I would introduce her kind of awkwardly as my not wife anymore.
sentences.zh: 当我们去某个地方而我要介绍她时，我会有些尴尬地把她介绍为“我不再是妻子的妻子”。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Dave.
sentences.zh: 戴夫。

sentences.en: Be like, hi, I'm Dave.
sentences.zh: 就像是：嗨，我是戴夫。

sentences.en: This is my not really my wife, Kristen.
sentences.zh: 这位其实已经不是我妻子的克里斯滕。

sentences.en: We're kind of married, but apparently we're not.
sentences.zh: 我们算是结婚了，但显然又没有。

sentences.en: And she would get she would get so angry.
sentences.zh: 而她会变得——她会变得极其愤怒。

sentences.en: What would she say?
sentences.zh: 她会说什么？

sentences.en: She would roll her eyes and go, oh, my God, I'm his wife.
sentences.zh: 她会翻个白眼说道：哦，天哪，我是他妻子。

sentences.en: I'm Kristen.
sentences.zh: 我是克里斯滕。

sentences.en: She did not love that I had taken off and put away my wedding ring and put that in a drawer and I replaced it with a skull ring that I had bought from an artist in Spain.
sentences.zh: 她极不高兴我摘下并收起了结婚戒指，把它放进抽屉里，然后用一枚我从西班牙一个艺术家那里买来的骷髅戒指取而代之。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: You're taking this.
sentences.zh: 你这是在……

sentences.en: You are confused, but you're taking it to a different level.
sentences.zh: 你很困惑，但你把这搞到了一个不同的层级。

sentences.en: Yeah, I I was very chippy about this.
sentences.zh: 是的，我对这件事表现得非常针锋相对。

sentences.en: This was like I didn't sign up for unmarried.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像是：我可没报名参加什么“解除婚姻”。

sentences.en: I didn't work this hard for the last six years to be floundering like this.
sentences.zh: 我过去六年可没这么努力，就是为了落得现在这般狼狈不堪的境地。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I wasn't introducing Kristen as my not really my wife anymore to get under her skin.
sentences.zh: 但我把克里斯滕介绍为“其实不再是我的妻子”，并不是为了故意激怒她。

sentences.en: I truly thought that I couldn't introduce her as my wife anymore and that I didn't know what else to call her since we were both clearly married.
sentences.zh: 我是真心觉得我不能再把她介绍为我的妻子了，而且既然我们俩显然已经不再是传统的夫妻状态，我也不知道该怎么称呼她了。

sentences.en: And I mean, through all this, you're watching Kristen seem comfortable with your new relationship dynamic.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，经历了这一切，你看着克里斯滕似乎对你们这种新的恋爱关系动态感到很自在。

sentences.en: She's having a life.
sentences.zh: 她有自己的生活。

sentences.en: She's having fun outside your relationship.
sentences.zh: 她在你们的亲密关系之外过得很开心。

sentences.en: And when you try to do similar things, it's not working.
sentences.zh: 而当你试图做类似的事情时，却行不通。

sentences.en: Was it confusing to you?
sentences.zh: 你当时感到困惑吗？

sentences.en: Was it was it painful?
sentences.zh: 这让人痛苦吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So what I was observing was.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时观察到的是。

sentences.en: Kristen doing the work that was helping her to thrive and it was bringing her back online.
sentences.zh: 克里斯滕正在做那些能帮她蓬勃发展的工作，这让她重新找回了状态。

sentences.en: It was bringing her joy back into the world.
sentences.zh: 这把她的快乐重新带回了这个世界。

sentences.en: She was alive again.
sentences.zh: 她又活过来了。

sentences.en: She was flourishing.
sentences.zh: 她正在繁盛。

sentences.en: And I was still struggling and I felt very lonely in that.
sentences.zh: 而我还在苦苦挣扎，在那种状态下我感到非常孤独。

sentences.en: There were periods where I even felt resentful, where I was like, so she has moved on from trying to be somebody who the marriage is all that makes her happy.
sentences.zh: 有过那么一段时间，我甚至感到怨恨，我当时想：所以她已经不再试图做一个让这段婚姻成为她全部快乐源泉的人了。

sentences.en: She's moved on from that.
sentences.zh: 她已经走出了那种状态。

sentences.en: She's running a different playbook now.
sentences.zh: 她现在换了一套行事规则。

sentences.en: And I felt sort of abandoned in my ridiculous best practices and frankly felt like I was floundering.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己被抛弃在了我那荒谬的“最佳实践”中，坦白说，我感觉自己像是在泥潭里挣扎。

sentences.en: And how long did it take for being unmarried to start making sense to you?
sentences.zh: 花了多长时间，“解除婚姻”这件事才开始对你变得有意义？

sentences.en: One of the very first times that I understood what she meant by unmarried, probably four or maybe five years after she introduced the idea to me,
sentences.zh: 我真正理解她所说的“解除婚姻”到底是什么意思，大约是在她向我引入这个概念的四五年之后，

sentences.en: was that she was done managing my energy.
sentences.zh: 那次我终于明白，她是不想再管理我的能量了。

sentences.en: Wait, four or five years?
sentences.zh: 等等，四五年？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So the next phrase that she coined after unmarried was energy manager.
sentences.zh: 所以她在“解除婚姻”之后创造的下一个词是“能量经理”。

sentences.en: And she was done running 10 steps ahead of me, making sure that the environment that I was in was something safe feeling and predictable and within my control.
sentences.zh: 她再也不想跑在我前面十步远的地方，去确保我所处环境给我的感觉是安全的、可预测的并且是在我的掌控之中的。

sentences.en: Because if I got into a bad mood, then she would get into a bad mood.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我情绪变差，她情绪就会变差。

sentences.en: So to avoid me getting into a bad mood and her ultimately feeling that same way, she would prevent the sort of things that she knew would trigger my bad moods.
sentences.zh: 所以为了避免我情绪变坏进而导致她自己也有同样的感觉，她会去极力阻止那些她知道会触发我坏情绪的事情发生。

sentences.en: And it was exhausting for her, and it was exhausting for her, and I didn't even know that she was doing this.
sentences.zh: 这对她来说太累了，对她而言简直是一种消耗，而我甚至都不知道她在这么做。

sentences.en: So she was this unwilling participant in my grand experiment to create the best possible husband.
sentences.zh: 所以，她成了我打造“完美丈夫”宏大实验中一个不情愿的参与者。

sentences.en: What she was saying was, I'm out of the experiment, and neither one of us needs to be working this hard all the time.
sentences.zh: 她当时的意思是：我退出了这个实验，我们俩谁都不需要一直这么辛苦地经营。

sentences.en: You stop trying to be this perfect husband.
sentences.zh: 你别再试图扮演这个完美的丈夫了。

sentences.en: I'm going to stop trying to manage your moods and your energy and being your partner in this big experiment.
sentences.zh: 我也要停止管理你的情绪和能量，不再做你这个宏大实验里的合伙人了。

sentences.en: I'm going to work on making myself happy.
sentences.zh: 我要去致力于让自己快乐。

sentences.en: I suggest you do the same.
sentences.zh: 我建议你也这么做。

sentences.en: If we're going to stay together, I really need you to be happy for yourself, by yourself, and then we come together in the middle and share that happiness.
sentences.zh: 如果我们还要在一起，我真的需要你为了你自己、靠你自己去获得快乐，然后我们再在中间相聚，分享彼此的快乐。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, that feels like progress.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来像是取得了进展。

sentences.en: I totally get what she's saying, too, about energy manager.
sentences.zh: 而且对于“能量经理”这个说法，我完全懂她的意思。

sentences.en: That's so real.
sentences.zh: 这太真实了。

sentences.en: But, I mean, now you have to manage your own energy.
sentences.zh: 但是，我的意思是，现在你得自己管理自己的能量了。

sentences.en: How did you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: A fellow classroom dad, you know, the parents of somebody my kids went to school with, pulled me aside and was like,
sentences.zh: 有个同班同学的爸爸，你知道的，就是我孩子学校某个同学的家长，把我拉到一边对我说：

sentences.en: Hey, you ever been mountain biking?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你骑过山地车吗？

sentences.en: You want to go mountain biking with us this weekend?
sentences.zh: 这周末你想跟我们一起去骑山地车吗？

sentences.en: Me and a group of guys are going.
sentences.zh: 我和一群哥们儿正准备去。

sentences.en: I was like, Oh, yeah, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说：哦，好啊，行。

sentences.en: And I was immediately addicted.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就上瘾了。

sentences.en: First ride, I was like, I need to do this every day for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 第一次骑完，我就觉得：我余下的每一个日子都必须做这件事。

sentences.en: And I am all in.
sentences.zh: 我全情投入了。

sentences.en: And Kristen said, Perfect, Dave.
sentences.zh: 克里斯滕说：太棒了，戴夫。

sentences.en: That's the sort of heat that you need to follow.
sentences.zh: 这正是你需要追寻的那股热情。

sentences.en: Like, follow that.
sentences.zh: 听着，去顺着这个方向走。

sentences.en: Chase that feeling.
sentences.zh: 去追逐那种感觉。

sentences.en: What does that feel like?
sentences.zh: 那感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: You don't need me to be part of that.
sentences.zh: 你不需要我成为其中的一部分。

sentences.en: Go find a hobby that lights you up.
sentences.zh: 去找一个能点燃你的爱好。

sentences.en: And so I was like, All right.
sentences.zh: 于是我说：好吧。

sentences.en: One of the first times where I thought, You know, maybe this unmarried isn't so bad.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次觉得：你知道的，也许这个“解除婚姻”也没那么糟。

sentences.en: I was flying weightlessly down the side of a mountain in Park City, Utah, having the time of my life, laughing out loud, hooting, hollering, feeling every turn and every jump
sentences.zh: 当时我正毫无重量感地从犹他州帕克城的山坡上飞驰而下，过着我一生中最快乐的时光，放声大笑，欢呼雀跃，去感受每一个转弯、每一个飞跃，

sentences.en: and every near-death experience with a tree or a rock and laughing the whole way down the mountain.
sentences.zh: 以及每一次与树木或岩石擦肩而过的九死一生的惊险，一路上伴随着大笑冲下山去。

sentences.en: And I got to the bottom and I thought, You know what?
sentences.zh: 等我到达山底时，我想：你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm here by myself.
sentences.zh: 我是独自一人来到这里的。

sentences.en: This feels like my soul is alive and on fire and I love it.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像我的灵魂正在鲜活燃烧，我爱这种感觉。

sentences.en: And I texted Kristen.
sentences.zh: 我给克里斯滕发了条短信。

sentences.en: I was like, I think I know what you mean.
sentences.zh: 我说：我想我明白你的意思了。

sentences.en: The previously married you, not the unmarried you, would not have done that, would not have leaned into this hobby, would not have leaned into this freedom?
sentences.zh: 如果是以前那个已婚的你，而不是现在这个解除婚姻状态的你，是绝对不会这么做的，绝对不会去尝试这个爱好，也绝对不会去拥抱这种自由吧？

sentences.en: No, because my Asperger model for faithful good husband was you do everything with your spouse, everything that you do that you enjoy, every hobby, every undertaking, every lawn
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我那套关于忠诚好丈夫的“阿斯伯格模型”就是：你得和你的配偶一起做任何事，你所做的每一件你喜欢的事、每一个爱好、每一个承办的项目、每一个草坪

sentences.en: project, every whatever is with your partner.
sentences.zh: 项目、无论什么事都必须和你的伴侣在一起。

sentences.en: I had become someone who was determined to be Dave Finch relative to his marriage with
sentences.zh: 我当时已经变成了一个一心只想成为“与克里斯滕的婚姻相契合的戴夫·芬奇”的人。

sentences.en: Kristen.
sentences.zh: 克里斯滕。

sentences.en: And if it's a good marriage, then I'm a good guy to be around.
sentences.zh: 如果婚姻美满，那我就是个值得交往的好人。

sentences.en: And if it's a bad marriage, then I suck.
sentences.zh: 如果婚姻糟糕，那我就是个废物。

sentences.en: But behind the scenes, Kristen had a different take.
sentences.zh: 但在幕后，克里斯滕却有不同的看法。

sentences.en: Like, she was looking at it like, he's going to all this trouble, all this effort, living and dying by rules.
sentences.zh: 比如，在她看来：他经历这一切麻烦、付出所有努力，完全是在靠规则苟延残喘。

sentences.en: And Kristen was like, Why don't you be Dave Finch?
sentences.zh: 而克里斯滕的意思是：你为什么不做回戴夫·芬奇呢？

sentences.en: I'll be Kristen Finch.
sentences.zh: 我会做回克里斯滕·芬奇。

sentences.en: We'll have our marriage.
sentences.zh: 我们会拥有我们的婚姻。

sentences.en: And Dave, your hobby cannot be our relationship.
sentences.zh: 但是戴夫，你的爱好绝不能等同于我们的关系。

sentences.en: I started to see that what Kristen really meant, and this is semantics, she probably meant anti-married.
sentences.zh: 我开始明白克里斯蒂娜真正想表达的是——这属于语义问题——她大概是指“反婚姻”。

sentences.en: The way that we are married is not working, we're going to flip it.
sentences.zh: 我们目前的婚姻相处模式行不通了，我们要把它彻底颠覆。

sentences.en: It was more of a divestment from all the things that were really holding us up in our relationship, as opposed to a termination of a marriage.
sentences.zh: 与其说这是终止婚姻，不如说这是剥离了所有那些让我们在感情中举步维艰的条条框框。

sentences.en: I just want to be clear, unmarried, anti-married kind of looks a lot like just being married.
sentences.zh: 我想澄清一下，不结婚、“反婚姻”听起来其实跟结婚差不多。

sentences.en: Yes, we are still totally subscribed to the traditional trappings of a marriage, meaning
sentences.zh: 是的，我们依然完全认同传统婚姻的形式，也就是说

sentences.en: we still live together, we are intimate with each other, we are exclusively faithful, neither
sentences.zh: 我们依然住在一起，彼此亲密，对彼此忠贞不二，我们两个

sentences.en: one of us has any intention, design, desire to go outside of the marriage for anything other than friendships and hobbies.
sentences.zh: 都没有任何意图、打算或渴望为了除友谊和爱好之外的任何事情而出轨。

sentences.en: It's more that we have parted ways with the other traditional trappings of marriage, which
sentences.zh: 更准确地说，我们只是抛弃了传统婚姻的其他形式，

sentences.en: is expectations and me needing you to be this thing that will never materialize, me needing the relationship to feel a certain way.
sentences.zh: 也就是各种期待，以及我需要你成为某种永远无法实现的事物、我需要这段感情呈现出某种特定样子的执念。

sentences.en: We are anti-married because by throwing those things aside, we actually have more room to
sentences.zh: 我们之所以“反婚姻”，是因为抛开这些东西之后，我们实际上有了更多的空间去

sentences.en: enjoy watching each other flourish, supporting each other, cheering each other on, being there when things are hard for each other.
sentences.zh: 欣赏彼此的绽放，支持彼此，为彼此呐喊助威，在对方遇到困难时陪伴左右。

sentences.en: The aspects of our marriage that we wanted in the first place, which is that joy of being together.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们当初想要的婚姻部分，也就是在一起的快乐。

sentences.en: The marriage that she was done having was the marriage where everything was a project.
sentences.zh: 她不想再要的那种婚姻，是凡事都像在做项目的婚姻。

sentences.en: She was looking at it like, he's going to all this effort.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，他付出了这么多的努力。

sentences.en: I just want to sit on the couch with him and watch TV.
sentences.zh: 而她只想和他一起坐在沙发上看电视。

sentences.en: I just want to take a road trip with him and the kids to an amusement park and just have fun together.
sentences.zh: 她只想和他还有孩子们一起去游乐园自驾游，开开心心地聚在一起。

sentences.en: I don't want everything to be a homework assignment.
sentences.zh: 她不想把每件事都变成家庭作业。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But now, thanks to Kristen's wisdom, we are committed to our own happiness first so that we can bring our happy selves to this relationship.
sentences.zh: 但现在，多亏了克里斯蒂娜的智慧，我们首先承诺对自己的幸福负责，这样我们就能把快乐的自己带入这段感情中。

sentences.en: When Kristen said, hey, Dave, we're detaching, we're unmarried, she knew that I wasn't going to organically feel my way through a very gray situation.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯蒂娜说，嘿，戴夫，我们要抽离了，我们不结婚了，她知道我不可能凭直觉去应付这种非常模糊的局面。

sentences.en: She knows that I need parameters.
sentences.zh: 她知道我需要条条框框。

sentences.en: I need language.
sentences.zh: 我需要语言来定义。

sentences.en: And I think she needed language, too.
sentences.zh: 我想她也需要明确的表达。

sentences.en: So, Dave, have you gotten better at navigating those gray areas?
sentences.zh: 那么，戴夫，你现在更擅长应付那些灰色地带了吗？

sentences.en: Like, can you give me an example of what it's been like for you to ease up on your project of having rules for everything in your life with Kristen?
sentences.zh: 比方说，你能举个例子吗？对你来说，不再执着于为生活中的每件事制定规则是什么体验？

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 我擅长了。

sentences.en: And here's an example.
sentences.zh: 这就是个例子。

sentences.en: This past Thanksgiving, Kristen decided, hey, we're going to do a Friendsgiving with her closest friend, basically her sister, her ride or die down in Texas.
sentences.zh: 去年感恩节，克里斯蒂娜决定，嘿，我们要和她最要好的朋友——基本上就是她的亲妹妹、德州生死之交的闺蜜——一起过一个“感恩挚友节”（Friendsgiving）。

sentences.en: And I said, sure, you know, we'll do a Friendsgiving.
sentences.zh: 我说，行啊，你知道的，我们来过个Friendsgiving。

sentences.en: But behind it, what I'm thinking is, well, wait, Thanksgiving is a very specific set of events that happen.
sentences.zh: 但在心底，我其实在想，等等，感恩节本来是一套非常具体的传统流程。

sentences.en: And now we're changing that.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们要改变它了。

sentences.en: Is this even going to be a Thanksgiving?
sentences.zh: 这还能算是感恩节吗？

sentences.en: Or is it going to be just a complete, you know, nebulous, undefined, scary fest for three or four days?
sentences.zh: 还是说，这会变成一个长达三四天、完全模糊不清、没有定义、让人害怕的狂欢节？

sentences.en: It wasn't even defined how long we would be there.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至都没确定要在那里待多久。

sentences.en: That's tough for you.
sentences.zh: 这对你来说很难受吧。

sentences.en: It is tough for me.
sentences.zh: 确实让我很难受。

sentences.en: And the first impulse that comes in to my mind is, all right, we need some parameters on this.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里冒出的第一个念头就是，好吧，我们得给这事定点规矩。

sentences.en: I need to understand how do they prepare their turkey?
sentences.zh: 我得弄明白他们是怎么做火鸡的？

sentences.en: Is it brined?
sentences.zh: 是用盐水腌制过的吗？

sentences.en: Is it deep fried?
sentences.zh: 是油炸的吗？

sentences.en: This is Texas.
sentences.zh: 这可是德州。

sentences.en: It's Dallas.
sentences.zh: 这里是达拉斯。

sentences.en: So is it going to be barbecued somehow, like under the ground with some kind of seasoning on it?
sentences.zh: 所以这火鸡会用某种方式做成烧烤吗，比如埋在地下烤，上面还撒着某种调料？

sentences.en: I don't know how they do it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是怎么做的。

sentences.en: And so then I decide, all right, you see what you're doing here, self.
sentences.zh: 于是我决定，好吧，你自己看看你在干什么。

sentences.en: You could beat yourself up for the next three or four weeks and try to understand this and be miserable by the time you get in the car to go to Dallas.
sentences.zh: 你可以跟自己较劲三四周，试图弄懂这一切，结果坐上车去达拉斯的时候整个人痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: Or you could set one rule.
sentences.zh: 或者，你可以定一条规矩。

sentences.en: And that one rule is, there really are no rules.
sentences.zh: 而这条规矩就是，其实根本没有规矩。

sentences.en: When we go down there, if you're having fun, then things are going in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 等我们到了那里，如果你觉得开心，那事情就是朝着正确的方向发展。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Did your hack of the one rule is there's no rules, did it work?
sentences.zh: 你这招“唯一的规矩就是没有规矩”的妙计，管用吗？

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 管用。

sentences.en: And I knew it was working the next morning on the drive because normally I insist on driving always.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上开车的时候我就知道它起作用了，因为平时我总是坚持自己开车。

sentences.en: And I actually let Kristen drive for a couple hours and we all just had fun in the car.
sentences.zh: 而这次我居然让克里斯蒂娜开了几个小时的车，我们在车里都玩得很开心。

sentences.en: And I think if you're on a family trip and you're all having fun, by the time you reach your destination, you're still having fun and laughing and it's going well.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果你在进行一场家庭旅行，大家都很开心，等你到达目的地时，你们依然在开心欢笑，一切都很顺利，

sentences.en: That's a miracle.
sentences.zh: 那就是个奇迹。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So after this 12, 13 hour drive, we pull into our friend's driveway.
sentences.zh: 所以在开了12、13个小时的车之后，我们把车开进了朋友家的车道。

sentences.en: And what I didn't know is that things were just going to get even better.
sentences.zh: 而我没想到的是，事情变得越来越好了。

sentences.en: These are like exceedingly decent people, which means that they do not tart up their Thanksgiving dinner.
sentences.zh: 他们是那种极其正派的人，这意味着他们不会把感恩节晚餐搞得花里胡哨。

sentences.en: It was a turkey.
sentences.zh: 那就是一只火鸡。

sentences.en: It was perfect.
sentences.zh: 太完美了。

sentences.en: Like everything you want in a turkey.
sentences.zh: 就像你对火鸡的所有期待那样。

sentences.en: Like it was just a turkey.
sentences.zh: 它就是一只简简单单的火鸡。

sentences.en: The best thing was the moments when Kristen would come over with either a glass of wine or a cup of tea or whatever,
sentences.zh: 最棒的时刻是，克里斯蒂娜端着一杯红酒或一杯茶什么的走过来，

sentences.en: Kristen would come over and just sit down next to me and
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜走过来，在我身边坐下，

sentences.en: kind of lay into me like a blanket.
sentences.zh: 像一条毯子一样软绵绵地靠在我身上。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: And I was like, all right, this is, I could do Friendsgiving if that's what this is.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，好吧，如果感恩节是这样的，那我可以接受。

sentences.en: I could do this every year.
sentences.zh: 我每年都可以这样过。

sentences.en: Like the whole thing from start to finish, as much as I wasn't sure about a Friendsgiving,
sentences.zh: 整件事情从头到尾，尽管一开始我并不确定自己能不能接受Friendsgiving，

sentences.en: I'm not sure I would do it any other way now.
sentences.zh: 但现在我敢说我绝不会用别的方式去过了。

sentences.en: Dave Finch, I truly feel like I took a masterclass in relationships and emotion in marriage.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·芬奇，我真的觉得我上了一堂关于婚姻中的感情与关系的硕士大师课。

sentences.en: After all this, do you still stand by your list of best practices?
sentences.zh: 经历这一切之后，你还坚持你那些最佳相处法则的清单吗？

sentences.en: All of the best practices amounted to a surface clean to fix myself so that I would appear to be the world's greatest partner.
sentences.zh: 以前所有的最佳相处法则不过是表面功夫，为了改造自己，好让我看起来像是世界上最棒的伴侣。

sentences.en: My bigger work then, my deeper clean, is to be somebody who goes out and creates for himself a life that they can then share with that chosen partner.
sentences.zh: 我后来更宏大的工作、更深层的打理，是去成为一个能够为自己创造生活、然后与所选伴侣共同分享这份生活的人。

sentences.en: But I stand by it, and so does Kristen.
sentences.zh: 但我依然坚持它，克里斯蒂娜也是。

sentences.en: There were a couple of clunkers.
sentences.zh: 其中有几个法则确实不太行。

sentences.en: Some of them were truly, admittedly...
sentences.zh: 其中有些坦白说真的是……

sentences.en: We all got some clunkers.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有点不太行的规矩。

sentences.en: Some of them were aspirational.
sentences.zh: 有些纯粹是好高骛远。

sentences.en: Well, the two that come to mind are the laundry thing, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我脑子里蹦出来的两个，一个是洗衣服的事，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I still, to this day, root through the dryer for the one or two things I need and leave the rest in there.
sentences.zh: 比如直到今天，我还是会在烘干机里翻找那一两件我需要的衣服，把剩下的全留在里面。

sentences.en: Oh, I wish you hadn't told me that.
sentences.zh: 哦，我真希望你没告诉过我这件事。

sentences.en: Oh, we'd come to such an understanding.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们之前明明达成过那么好的共识。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry, Anna.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉，安娜。

sentences.en: You just hurt my heart, but okay.
sentences.zh: 你真让我伤心，不过好吧。

sentences.en: I have my limitations, and that's one of them.
sentences.zh: 我能力有限，这正是其中之一。

sentences.en: I'll take it one step further.
sentences.zh: 我再进一步坦白吧。

sentences.en: Since I am no longer somebody who pines for everyone to like him, I'll admit this to you as well.
sentences.zh: 既然我不再渴望讨好所有人了，我也对你承认这一点。

sentences.en: Not only do I do that, I will root through the dirty clothes hamper to take out my dirty stuff and just wash that.
sentences.zh: 我不仅会这么做，我还会去脏衣篮里翻找我自己的脏衣服，然后只洗那些。

sentences.en: Because it makes it so much easier when it's in the dryer for me to just take it out because I don't have to sift through other people's clothes.
sentences.zh: 因为衣服只要在烘干机里，我拿出来就轻松多了，不用去翻找别人的衣服。

sentences.en: All right, listeners, you can direct your hate mail to...
sentences.zh: 好吧，听众朋友们，你们的愤怒邮件可以寄往……

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的政治机器在运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了大批自封为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党便陷入了一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至令人惊心动魄的权力争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持自身影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.zh: 《都市》。
